<\STATESEP>theory Guess_ExI

  Eisbach_Tools.Eisbach_Methods

begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>method abs_used for P = (match (P) in "\<lambda>s. ?P" \<Rightarrow> \<open>fail\<close> \<bar> _ \<Rightarrow> \<open>-\<close>)<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>method in_conj for P Q = (
      match (Q) in "P" \<Rightarrow> \<open>-\<close>
    | match (Q) in "\<lambda>y. A y \<and> B y"  for A B  \<Rightarrow>
            \<open> match (A) in "(Q' :: 'b)" for Q' \<Rightarrow> \<open>match (B) in "(Q'' :: 'b)"  for Q'' \<Rightarrow>
             \<open> in_conj P Q' | in_conj P Q''\<close>\<close>\<close>
    )<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>method guess_exI =
    (require_determ \<open>(match conclusion in "\<exists>x. Q x" for Q \<Rightarrow>
                            \<open>match premises in "P y" for P y \<Rightarrow>
                             \<open>abs_used P, in_conj P Q, rule exI[where x=y]\<close>\<close>)\<close>)<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma fun_uncurry:
  "(P \<longrightarrow> Q \<longrightarrow> R) \<longleftrightarrow> (P \<and> Q) \<longrightarrow> R"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. (P \<longrightarrow> Q \<longrightarrow> R) = (P \<and> Q \<longrightarrow> R)<\STATESEP>by auto<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>method guess_spec_inner for P uses I =
    ((match I in "\<forall>x. C x \<longrightarrow> _ x" for C \<Rightarrow> \<open>in_conj P C\<close> ))<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>method guess_spec =
    (require_determ \<open>(match premises in I:"\<forall>x. _ x \<longrightarrow> _ x" \<Rightarrow>
                            \<open>match premises in "P y" for P y \<Rightarrow>
                            \<open>abs_used P, guess_spec_inner P I:I[simplified fun_uncurry],
                                         insert I, drule spec[where x=y]\<close>\<close>)\<close>)<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>experiment begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma

 1. \<lbrakk>P x; \<forall>x. Q x \<longrightarrow> P x \<longrightarrow> R\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> R<\STATESEP>by (guess_spec, blast intro: Q)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma
    assumes Q: "Q x"
